question: Select the most appropriate option to fill blank 4
solution:
The correct answer is **Leading.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given options the correct option to fill in the blank is **Leading.**
 
• **Leading:** Resulting to
 
 
• **Example:** *Her talking to that girl led to the permanence of her job.*
 
 

The complete sentence is: **The Goal SDG-4.1 states that “By 2030, ensure that all boys and girls complete free, equitable and quality primary and secondary education leading to relevant and effective learning outcomes”.**
